newsitem.title: USA: Report of smoke on plane closes Newark Airport.
newsitem.headline: Report of smoke on plane closes Newark Airport.

text.p: Smoke was reported Friday in the cockpit of a Boston-bound plane at Newark International Airport but all 59 passengers and crew were evacuated safely.

The incident, reported at about 1:30 p.m. EST, forced the closing of the airport to landings for about 15 minutes, said Terrie Benzcik, a spokeswoman for the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey, which oversees operations at the airport.
The smoke was reported in the cockpit of Continental Flight 354, an MD-80 aircraft taking off for Boston with 54 passengers and five crewmembers, she said.

The plane was taxiing down a runway when the crew noticed an odour of smoke in the cabin, David Messing, a spokesman for Continental, said. There was no immediate explanation for the odour, he said, adding that the incident was being investigated.
